name: GetNeighborhoodManager
source: lane DN: LoadNeighborhoods 0x476a40 calls slots 10 / 12 of it with a hood file prefix, which are cTSNeighborhoodManager GetByName 0x4a5190 / GetNamedList 0x4a3bc0

name: GetByName
source: lane DN: 0x4a5190 (verified): the neighbourhood info of the name (case insensitive), or null; not AddRefed (LoadNeighborhoods does not release it)

name: GetNamedList
source: lane DN: 0x4a3bc0 (verified): copies the name's list of sub-neighbourhood infos into a service-allocator vector of counted pointers; whether it is non-empty
